answer: Locks are published in violet, expire in garden, and cedar lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 25 aliases hence needs 93 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2527 identities would post 2776 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
